bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for sewer and water infrastructure in the city of Tower; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. TOWER; SEWER AND WATER INFRASTRUCTURE.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation.

$2,200,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the Public Facilities Authority for a grant to the city of Tower to design and construct improvements to municipal sewer and water infrastructure. This appropriation includes money for expansion of sewer and water infrastructure to provide new service to businesses and residents and to support two new housing developments and for the replacement of existing old and failing sewer and water infrastructure to address inflow and infiltration. This appropriation also includes money for street reconstruction and other improvements associated with the project.

Subd. 2.

Bond sale.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $2,200,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $2,200,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the Public Facilities Authority for a grant to the city of Tower to design and construct improvements to municipal sewer and water infrastructure. This appropriation includes money for expansion of sewer and water infrastructure to provide new service to businesses and residents and to support two new housing developments and for the replacement of existing old and failing sewer and water infrastructure to address inflow and infiltration. This appropriation also includes money for street reconstruction and other improvements associated with the project.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $2,200,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
